_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

additional_data._notes: Source-supported data that cannot be represented faithfully by any existing universal schema field. Do not duplicate data already represented elsewhere. Do not use this section for unknown values, assumptions, or inferred data.

facts: 5 points per INR 100 via AU Rewardz; 500 bonus points requires five INR 500 transactions in a cycle.

open_questions: Network: UNRESOLVED after a second sweep on 2026-11-07 (wave 3, W7). Only a "Visa Cardholders" popup on the page points to Visa, and that block is shared with other AU cards. Checked and found silent: the Tejas card art (listing tile and product-page art, no network mark on the front), the Tejas welcome T&C and the District, Amazon FreshNow, Zomato, cab and bill-payment partner T&Cs, AU's 6 May 2026 portfolio press release and the Q1 FY27 results note, KFS v1.9 and MITC v2.23 (they name a network only for the CheQ Visa), and the Cardmember Agreement of 16 May 2026 (clauses 3.14 to 3.16 allow a network change at renewal and use "VISA/RuPay" for every card). Tejas has no lounge benefit, so no lounge T&C exists to read. visa.co.in, mastercard.co.in, npci.org.in and rupay.co.in carry no AU card list. Needs a physical card, the AU 0101 app card view, or a written answer from AU (1800 1200 1500; creditcard.support@aubank.in). card_product.network left null.

Reward Point value in rupees: not stated for Tejas. AU Rewardz FAQ and Cardmember Agreement clause 22.11 (16 May 2026 copy; 23.11 in the undated copy) say the conversion rate differs by card variant and point to the variant page, and the Tejas page, FAQ and welcome T&C state none (the welcome choice of 2,000 points or a ₹500 voucher is a choice, not a conversion). effective_base_return_percent left null.
Exclusion MCC lists are not published for Tejas (categories only).
The 25,000-point per-cycle cap on all MCCs is from the CMA 23.5 table, which lists Tejas. No separate cap is stated for the 5-point portal rate.
notes: Resolved from the page FAQ: the 5-point rate is earned only on purchases made through the AU Rewardz portal (flights, hotels, voucher shopping, bill payments); all other spends earn 1 point per ₹100; at most 100 points per utility or telecom transaction.
Bonus 500 Reward Points: need at least 5 transactions of ₹500 or more within one statement cycle (page FAQ). Not modelled because the milestone schema is spend-based, not transaction-count-based.
Reward Points are earned in multiples of ₹100 (CMA 23.22), modelled as floor; points expire after 2 years (CMA 23.8).

Partner offers: each is 10% (max ₹50, minimum transaction ₹150, once per month) at District, Amazon Fresh, Zomato, Uber/Ola/Rapido and AU 0101 bill payments (FAQ table). Recorded as partner offers, not reward rates.
Also listed on the page: Card Liability Cover, Credit Shield, Device Protection Plan (no cover amounts given).
